Its extended handle lets you glide it smoothly across the face, neck, and body, and practitioners and users regularly report support for relaxation, circulation, and nervous system regulation. A biofield tuning practitioner, he uses tuning forks to help clients resolve physical symptoms, break negative patterns, and return to energetic coherence.

recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Bio: Gabriel, known on air as Slick Dissident, co-hosts InnerVerse's Vibe Rant show and is a longtime recurring guest on the podcast. He teaches occult symbolism and tarot on his YouTube channel, ranging across the Major Arcana, the esoteric Enneagram, mythology and archetype, mystic linguistics, and the symbolism hidden in popular film. He is best known for Tarot-tories, his own system mapping the 22 Major Arcana and zodiac archetypes onto the geography of the United States.
recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Name: Gabe (Slick Dissident)

recR9a4OItodWBnvP.Bio: Emily Ridout is a folklorist and AstroYoga specialist who blends astrology, yoga, and tarot; she appeared on InnerVerse (multiple times) to discuss her book AstroYoga for an Aquarian Age.
recR9a4OItodWBnvP.Name: Emily Ridout

reckIvJxU4wRhybxA.Bio: Mario Garza is the artist and researcher behind Symbolic Studies, a project sharing symbolic insights on the zodiac, mythology, folklore and world religions, with astrology as its foundation. A lifelong artist who has worked as an art director and graphic designer for nearly 25 years, he runs Symbolic Studies from the Pacific Northwest alongside his wife Michelle, who co-hosts the podcast with him. His work traces syncretic threads across tarot, occultism and comparative religion, including the argument that the major deities of antiquity were originally polar gods before a solar model was laid over them. He also offers symbolic birth chart and tarot readings, private lessons and freelance design.
reckIvJxU4wRhybxA.Name: Mario Garza

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Solstice Light and the Cancer Season Sky", "body": "Emily argued that the summer solstice marked the zenith of the light, and she stressed that this was literal, saying our bodies were made of light and that even the food we eat traced back to sunlight. She recommended a sun gazing practice. She described Cancer season as a time when both the sun and the moon were strong, and said a new moon at seven degrees Cancer would sit with Black Moon Lilith. Emily presented Lilith as the dark feminine and taught that facing darkness bravely leads toward joy."}, {"title": "Full Moon Fallout and the April Conjunction", "body": "Emily recapped the previous day's full moon, which she said squared Neptune and grew out of the Neptune Jupiter conjunction in April. She argued that people were releasing jobs, relationships and ideas that no longer fit, and that mutable signs were being cleared most. One of the hosts asked whether she had tracked the Schumann Resonance, and Emily replied that she had not studied it much, though she liked resonance and had researched seismic resonance when she was young. The hosts traded notes on how wild the day felt."}, {"title": "Sacral Chakra Clearing Through Mirror Gazing", "body": "Emily argued that a collective sacral chakra clearing had been under way since April, and that pleasure, creativity and self worth depended on a healthy second chakra. Her main suggestion was mirror gazing alone, looking into the left eye for the feminine side and the right eye for the visionary side while breathing into the sacral area. She cautioned that less is more and that purification should be given time to settle. Mario called the practice completely sound and a reminder that everything a person needs is already within."}, {"title": "Do Planetary Myths Shape Our Lives", "body": "Chance wondered aloud whether the mythology applied to the sky clock influences how our lives develop, comparing language to an operating system that is useful when it is a good one. Emily answered that, according to the traditions she follows, humans control nothing and our agency derives from one underlying force. She said it was not the visible Jupiter controlling anyone but an internal Jupiter moving at the same pace, and she tied the Lord's Prayer to lining up with the sky clock. Chance said he saw it the same way."}, {"title": "Serpents, Seven, and the North Star", "body": "The conversation circled through snake symbolism. Emily linked the snake to Scorpio and the Kundalini power, one of the hosts tied certain tarot keys and the caduceus to serpent imagery, and a host argued that Moses, Messiah and snake oil share a Hebrew root. Later, a host explained that the number seven had been woven to the North because both dippers have seven stars, and noted that Black Moon Lilith sat at seven degrees of Cancer. Emily said seven meant victory in the occult sciences and cautioned against meditation practices that pull consciousness out of the body."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Astro-yoga specialist and folklore-master Emily Ridout returns to Vibe Rant for a special solstice space-weather update! Emily is a teacher and practitioner that helps her students syncretize their bodily movements to those of the seasons and the heavens above.
